choose.editor: Choose the editor Atlas opens. You can change it here later.
choose.terminal: Choose the terminal Atlas opens. You can change it here later.

help.terminal: Opens a new {app} window in {folder}. Atlas types nothing into it, and the session stays in the window it runs in.

refused: {target} was not opened: {reason} Nothing was started.

reason.outside: It is outside the folder Atlas was given.
reason.appMissing: {app} is no longer installed. Press Change application.

none.editor: No editor Atlas can open was found on this Mac. Copy the path to open it yourself.
none.terminal: No terminal Atlas can open was found on this Mac. Copy the folder path to open it yourself.

otherSystem: Atlas opens editors and terminals on macOS only. Copy the path to open it yourself.
pullRequest: Find its pull request on GitHub
pullRequestHelp: Opens github.com in your browser and searches {repo} for pull requests from {branch}. Your browser sends that request. Atlas sends nothing.
